fusions.name: Still-Held Shot
fusions.desc: After 1.5 seconds holding perfectly still, fires a shot that deals 38 damage and is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Startle Report
fusions.desc: Breaks cover with a crack of flame in a cone 3 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold Your Breath
fusions.desc: After 1 second of stillness, your critical hit chance rises 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Sighting
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
